findings.description: The notification message 'Action unsuccesful, please try again' is misspelled ('unsuccesful'); the intended word is 'unsuccessful', as used in the page's other copy.
repro: Click 'Click here' repeatedly (reload between clicks) until the message reads 'Action unsuccesful, please try again'

notes: Tested all 27 brief pages over HTTP and in Chromium: status codes, console and page errors, broken images, login and logout, dynamic controls, add/remove, dropdown, checkboxes, inputs, key presses, status codes, table sorting, dynamic loading, hovers, JS dialogs, notifications, and load timings (no slow pages found on repeat runs). Expected test-fixture behaviour was not reported: /broken_images 404s, /javascript_error page error, /typos, and external resource ERR_NAME_NOT_RESOLVED (no network). Copy typo 'differant numbor' on /shifting_content/menu was seen but not reported, as it is probably upstream copy.

cost.notes: estimate from 81917 total tokens (85% cache read / 10% input / 5% output); range $0.0008-$0.0098
